comment: GYM GATE WIRING, gym 3 (Lt. Surge, Vermilion Gym) - the production trigger for the flag-consuming gym battle; the data-level contract the host applies lives in data/gym_gate_triggers.json. Availability is enforced by the bound machinery, not by this script: the battle step runs PUWBattleEntry.start_gym_battle with use_campaign_gate, so PUWCampaignStitch.can_start_gym_battle -> PUWGymRequirements checks data/gym_requirements.json's kanto_gym_3_surge record against live state (story flag ss_anne_cleared - set by data/events/ss_anne_captain.json - plus the hm01 item it grants, plus the cut field action) and the battle is refused before those are earned by play. badge_count is step data the host overwrites with the live GLOBAL badge count before running (the Oak fixture's step-data convention - the same way its picks are host-supplied); the value 0 here is a placeholder for that overwrite, never a claim about the player's progress. On a win the host calls PUWCampaignStitch.record_gym_win(state, 'kanto_gym_3_surge') (see the triggers file). Surge's pre-battle line is the bank's only VermilionGym leader label.
